integrity: The proof is analytic; the included exact-arithmetic script checks only equivalent closed forms in finitely many dimensions.
The literature comparison is best-knowledge and independent audit has not been performed.
scientific_limitations: Uniform normalized Hausdorff surface measure on the cross-polytope boundary only.
The result is for the affine-function L2 projector; higher-degree spaces and other measures are not covered.
The asymptotic stated is d/2+O(1); no stronger expansion is needed for the claim.
title: Exact norm and positivity defect of the affine \(L^2\) projector on the cross-polytope boundary
